about.heroText: LocalKarar is a decision-support application for small and medium-sized businesses. It helps you make decisions based on your own figures instead of guesswork.
about.audienceText: Designed for shop, workshop, e-commerce, and service business owners who want to track their figures without needing an accounting background. It works for solo businesses and small teams.
about.limitsText: LocalKarar is not accounting software and does not replace professional legal, tax, accounting, or investment advice. Its results depend on the data you enter, and the decision remains yours.
about.closingTitle: All you need to start is an account
about.closingText: No setup is required. After creating an account, a few questions introduce your business.

support.title: Help and contact
support.intro: Answers to common situations are below. If you cannot find what you need, complete the form and we will reply to the address you provide.
support.guideIntro: The application's main flow has five steps. You do not need to complete all of them; start with the section that helps you.

verificationEmail.question: I didn't receive the verification email. What should I do?
verificationEmail.answer: Check your spam and promotions folders first. The code is valid for 15 minutes; if it expires, request a new one from the banner in the app. If you entered the wrong address, change it in Settings.

forgotPassword.question: I forgot my password.
forgotPassword.answer: Use the Forgot Password link on the sign-in screen. The link is valid for one hour and can be used once. Reset emails are sent only to verified addresses; you will not receive one before verifying your address.

session.question: Why do I have to sign in every time?
session.answer: Your session remains open for 30 days. If it ends earlier, you may have visited the site sometimes with “www” and sometimes without it—browsers treat them as separate sites. The address now redirects to one format; contact us if the issue continues.

workspace.question: What is a business workspace for?
workspace.answer: It is where you keep income, expenses, accounts, and documents. You can invite others to a business through a single-use link sent by email.

invoice.question: How is a record created from an uploaded invoice?
invoice.answer: The document text is read and a record is suggested. Nothing is written to your business records until you approve it. You can edit or reject the suggestion.

mentor.question: Can I trust information from AI Mentor?
mentor.answer: AI Mentor uses a language model and may produce confident but incorrect information. Where possible, it grounds answers in our content library and shows the source. Verify figures, rates, deadlines, and regulations with official sources before acting. AI Mentor does not replace an accountant or lawyer.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: Our servers are in France. Mentor conversations are processed by Mistral AI in France and retained for 30 days for abuse monitoring; they are not used for model training. See the Privacy and KVKK Notice for details.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Go to Settings → Delete account. If you are the sole owner of a business, assign another member as owner first. The Privacy Notice explains what happens to your data after deletion.

affordable.question: Why is it so affordable?
affordable.answer: Because we are at an early stage. Founding members use the product as we grow and shape it with their feedback. In return, they keep the price advantage permanently.

freeMonth.question: What happens when the free month ends?
freeMonth.answer: Your data remains stored and exportable. If you do not start a membership, the account becomes read-only; adding records, calculations, and AI Mentor are disabled. None of your data is deleted.

cancel.question: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.answer: Yes. After cancellation, your membership continues through the paid period. You do not need to contact anyone; cancel with one click under Settings → Membership.

invoice.question: Can I get an invoice?
invoice.answer: Yes. The document issued after payment is sent to your email address, and you can access previous invoices under Settings → Membership.

increase.question: What happens if prices go up?
increase.answer: The founder price is not frozen; it is tied to the standard price. If the standard price rises, yours rises too — but it always stays {{percent}}% below it. So you are not exempt from increases, you are simply affected less than other members. You will be notified before any price change.

yearly.question: Should I choose monthly or yearly?
yearly.answer: With yearly billing you pay for 10 months instead of 12, saving {{saving}} a year. Monthly billing gives you flexibility and you can leave whenever you like. You choose at checkout and can change it later.
